messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "non-cirrhotic MASH"
set: ["non-cirrhotic MASH", "non-cirrhotic metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) in adults", "non-diet soda", "non-enteric coated form", "not broken down by the liver", "mix with an undesirable, nontoxic substance", "shell that is not absorbed or melted in the body", "cases without cirrhosis of the liver", "metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH)", "mix with small amount of applesauce, apple juice, or water", "not constipation", "allow it to dissolve in your mouth without chewing", "mix the medicine with soft food", "alcohol-containing beverages", "non-NSAID analgesics", "mix with 4 ounces (half a cup) of water, ginger ale, lemon or lime soda, lemonade, or orange juice"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
